title: Quantitative Error Estimates for Learning Macroscopic Mobilities from Microscopic Fluctuations
summary: We develop quantitative error estimates connecting microscopic fluctuation of interacting particle systems with the mobilities of their hydrodynamic limits. Focusing on the Symmetric Simple Exclusion Process and systems of independent Brownian particles, we provide explicit bounds for the discrepancy between the quadratic variation of fluctuation fields and the corresponding mobilities, in terms of time and spatial discretization parameters.
